standard: Pakistan Halal Authority Act 2016; PSQCA PS 3733:2010 and PS 4992:2010
import_recognition: Accredited certification bodies must be recognised by the Government of Pakistan
notes: The Act bars marketing anything as halal without the Authority's logo, so certification is mandatory for a halal claim. No route for cell-based food found. Statute text not read.

standard: No unifying halal law; FSSAI licence for food
import_recognition: Halal certificate not needed for trade permission, but required by GCC, Malaysia, Indonesia and other OIC markets for exports
notes: From the USDA 2022 overview as summarised in search results. i-CAS from PLAN.md not sourced here. FSSAI novel-food route not checked.

body: Saudi Food and Drug Authority, Saudi Halal Center
import_recognition: Importers need halal and halal-shipment certificates from bodies recognised by the Saudi Halal Center
notes: A 2026 review (HS-009) reports that neither the SFDA nor the Saudi Halal Center had authorised or certified cultured meat. Secondary source.

notes: From search summaries of MoIAT pages; not opened. Novel-food route not searched.
